$comment: Time-boxed dependency vulnerability exceptions for Snehavrinda Kala.
This file is EMPTY on purpose. Every high/critical advisory reported by
`node apps/storefront/scripts/audit-deps.mjs` was fixed by upgrading the
dependency tree during the security closure (see
resort, not a habit: if you add one, it must name the exact installed
version, the exact dependency path, and the exact advisory.
1. advisory must be a real CVE-* or GHSA-* identifier (no package-wide ignores);
2. installedVersion must match the version the audit reports — a version
bump invalidates the exception instead of silently carrying it forward;
3. dependencyPath must match a path the audit reports — a new consumer
4. severity must match the advisory severity;
5. expiresAt must be at most 14 days after approvedAt and must not be in the past;
6. a critical advisory additionally needs criticalAuthorized: true;
7. exploitability, reachability and remediationPlan are mandatory.
An invalid or expired entry suppresses nothing and fails the build.
